correctness.rationale: For W=AcB the only candidate parents are AA and BB, as a one-position deletion leaves at least one entire outer block. If both parents are distinct, B is a deletion from Ac and A from cB. Let r be the first differing position. The former deletion can be placed at r, since any earlier deletion leaves equality up to r−1 only by shifting an initial equal-letter run within the deletion interval. It follows that B_t=A_{t+1} for t≥r with A_{m+1}=c. The latter deletion must remove B_j with j≥r or A_r would equal B_r. Thus A_1=c and A_t=B_{t−1} up to r. Equality before r forces A_1 through A_r all to be c, so the shift relation holds throughout; W=AAa_1 with a_1=c. The converse uses end deletions, and nonconstant A gives two distinct parents. Count incidence using q(2m+1) insertion histories per codeword minus 2m run redundancies; this yields all three histogram cells and excludes higher multiplicity. The graph components have sizes d dividing m, in numbers P_q(d) by primitive period Möbius inversion. An even cycle has two alternating maximum sets; for odd d there is exactly one gap with two unselected vertices, whose freely chosen position gives d maximum sets. Handle d=1 and d=2 as a singleton and an edge. This proves the sum/product, and smaller periods contribute O_q(q^{m/2}) words. Independently enumerated received words for q=2 through m=6, q=3 through m=4 and q=4 through m=3; all histograms, parent identities and edges agree.
